billingsHint: Value of the client work you completed this month
shareHint: How much of the month's break-even your billings cover
bonusHint: Your share of the pool above break-even
aboveBreakEven: The team is above break-even: the bonus pool is growing.
belowBreakEven: The team has not reached break-even yet.
noBreakEven: No break-even is set for this month yet.
noTickets: No completed client work this month yet.
settingsHint: Break-even is what the month must bill to cover costs. The pool is the share of billings above it paid out as bonuses, split by each person's share of billings.
